contract.title: D2 dynamic topology post-integration cold-start review
contract.goal: Review exact commit 0cff2547c59ca2d8f66d690f6b922d6bf71588b9. Check rematching interval and deterministic matching, geometry legality, link retirement, queued data/control and in-flight service semantics, holding queue conservation/FIFO/area, state-version and routing structure rebuilds, receipt counters, and test adequacy. Explicitly determine whether queued control/data are intentionally drained on retired links while queued data is moved to holding, and whether this is consistent and fail-closed. Return APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES with FACT/INFERENCE/UNVERIFIED, exact path/line evidence, reproduction conditions, severity and open_items. Do not modify code.
acceptance: Every major finding has exact evidence and reproduction condition
requiredEvidence: Exact commit-bound GitHub paths and line references
Explicit analysis of retired-link queued data/control and in-flight behavior
